description.intro: With the Barça 25/26 Match T-shirt for kids, your little one will feel the thrill of the game as a real professional. Its high performance DFADV technology offers maximum breathability and fit to accompany him in every move with comfort and style.
key_benefits: Professional version: Advanced technology and optimized fit for young footballers.
Extreme breathability: Technical fabric that maximizes ventilation.
Dynamic adjustment: Ergonomic design that allows freedom of movement.
Barça identity: Shield and official colors to feel part of the team.
Upper Lightness: Manufacture with ultra-light and resistant materials.
